verbatim_agent_sentence: We choose to hold this position as the thesis is on track and the long-term compounding potential remains consistent with our standards for a core holding [D09, D10].
grader_notes: The agent identifies the core drivers of the business (synergies, management, network moat) consistent with the long-term thesis but misses the actual investment decision to sell.
